title: Conditional κ = 0.001698511924002761: optimal owner fill on #2435's entrance-raised words
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001698511924002761437757966262255027756475230301463200108591…** (3046 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `d36180ca6522330fe77637c45dc47d7985aaa0e59dbcdc52ec64334ef9500cab`). This package is PR2435's construction (ours: PR2322's handoff construction of Vlado Vojdanovski, our exact owner fill PR2374, and the entrance raise of 24 copy-buffer helpers per word from dimension 1 to 2, width 8 to 7) with a better owner fill: the pattern-optimal fill for the same words, order, windows and widths, new in this package, by Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance (leftover idle {1:20822, 3:6694, 5:2, 48:25302}; every window, bin, helper and family rule checked literally). The missing move was identified publicly by PR2442 (thakrarsagar), and PR2446 (thakrarsagar) independently verified PR2435. Words, natives, provider widths and everything else are unchanged. The entrance frames are bound to the hosted helpers explicitly: `new/rebuild_borrow.py` checks, for each word, that the per-helper width |final| - |start_extra| equals the ordered widths of new/BORROW-PROVIDERS.json used for every hosted role, and rejects a raised buffer delivered at dimension 1 again; the audit stage rejects wrong per-call residual widths. Also carried: private cleanup-buffer stock accounting (PR2309, PR2315; physical stock 66826), the pooled-slot time binding (PR2301, PR1959) and the 1e-3000 endpoints with the fixed-grid-maximum outer kappa C - 1/F - B (PR2180 / PR2161; PR2168). Conditional final kappa = 0.0016985119240027614377579662622550277564…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0016956318730476708322470897317373993996…(2995 digits)). It exceeds PR2435 by 5.80305E-10 (exact gate in verify_release.py). grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116; 63 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls.


**Entrance frames: what is proved where.** The `ENTRANCE-WIDTH-BINDING` stage, `code/bind_providers_portable.py` and the emit/audit width checks bind the *dimensions* of the 24 raised entrance frames to the widths used for hosting; on their own they do not prove the frames' *contents*. The contents of every `start_extra` frame are established by the exact forward and dual replay in `new/borrow/audit_local.py` and by the native chain, both of which consume the same `start_extra` frames. Together these answer the open point in PR2446.

## Verification

Fresh checkout of `805bbaddf664459c1eb92aa461645cd69764c86e` (text-only follow-up to `0a0c8b87ef1dcc6a1eceea9ed567f8217871fa88`: README de-duplicated, hosting scope of the width stages stated; kappa unchanged). Manifest: `915288cb1d143dd5a04bf4789eb607fcfb0bb1d38bfa9984996e271bfad4246a`.
PASS package manifest: 437 files

Supplier: the package's own unchanged `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls): `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`, native reuse {'base': 'e8e6e78ff7422275c38324499e1f33fb2ecd30de9503aef2b8f1ee80d8c4df8e', 'extra': '7b0e9fbda32749aabc7e156d9fe09bceb0624a178628fe69e5dfea783462f905'}; its complex endpoint 132696244062715737324841114238... brackets the ledger's b = 1698511924002761437757966262255027756475…(3078 digits)/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000…(3081 digits). Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained rows plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, the fixed-grid maximum kappa = C - 1/F - B asserted, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0016985119240027614377579662622550277564…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-(1025/1024)e-3080, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md; fixed-grid maximum of PR2180/PR2161 (dataisfire), outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md; exact-integer coarse exponential PR2168/PR2184 (dataisfire) at the one 3000-digit rejection call).

Full package-owned verification passed in 183.6 seconds on the new head (PASS_RELEASE, kappa identical). The fresh receipt binds the exact package manifest and score.

See `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/README.md` for reproduction commands and proof qualifications.
